reasoning: This project is a pipeline definition and deployment configuration for running InstructLab on Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI). It uses the Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) SDK to define a Data Science Pipeline that orchestrates InstructLab's synthetic data generation (SDG), distributed model training, and evaluation stages on OpenShift. The repository contains: (1) Python KFP pipeline component definitions (sdg/, training/, eval/) and a pipeline compiler (pipeline.py) that produces pipeline.yaml, (2) Kubernetes manifests for supporting infrastructure (model serving, NFS storage, Prometheus), and (3) Dockerfiles and image references for pipeline execution. It is not an operator (no controller/reconciler), not a library (not meant for import by other projects), and not a service (no long-running server). It is best classified as configuration — it packages pipeline workflow definitions and Kubernetes manifests that configure how InstructLab is deployed and orchestrated on RHOAI infrastructure.
